name: Zul'Gurub: a flat damage-taken reduction lowers each Razor Claws stack once, not once per stack squared
contract: Round-7 tester (2026-11-14, Mythic, M0 gear): Thick Pelt (556233, physical damage taken -354) nearly erased a
44-stack Razor Claws bleed (2118328, 213 per stack on Mythic). Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken multiplied the flat
taken benefit by the stack count twice, once in the coefficient and once in the level factor, so the
reduction grew with the square of the stacks. A flat reduction now applies once per stack: a 44-stack tick
under Thick Pelt -354 takes exactly 44 times the one-stack tick (43.5-44.5 allows integer rounding), and the
one-stack tick is still reduced below its 213 base.

steps.label: The hero carries Thick Pelt at the tester's -354
CONTROL: Thick Pelt lowers physical damage taken by 354
CONTROL: Thick Pelt reduces a one-stack Mythic bleed tick
DISCRIMINATING: a 44-stack tick takes 44 one-stack ticks, not a stack-squared reduction
